The '''Khai estate''' was a household on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] that was home to the [[Khai family]]. [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Lahka Khai|Lahka]], lived there with their daughter, [[Vestara Khai|Vestara]]. They also housed at least one [[Slavery/Legends|servant]], the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Muura]], who helped take care of Vestara. In [[41 ABY]], Vestara was chosen as a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] and forced to leave the home and move into the [[Kesh Sith Temple]], and Muura was dismissed from the household as her services were no longer needed. Two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[43 ABY|later]], Vestara was sent on a [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|mission]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and soon afterward, Gavar was sent on a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to kill Skywalker and capture the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]]. While Gavar and Vestara were gone, Lahka kept the household in good condition, and she kept [[Vestara's chamber|Vestara's room]] ready for the girl to return at any time.
